'Ensuring Every Child THRIVES'
Welcome
Welcome to Broughton Community Schools. We are a federation of two Aylesbury Town Schools, Broughton Infant School and Broughton Junior School. After our federation in February 2021, we have continued to build and form one school family across two neighbouring sites with the aim of providing the best all through primary education for our children.
Thank you for your interest regarding Broughton Junior School. If you would like further information, please see our Community Schools Website here.

pageCache.text:
Year 5 and 6 Residential 2026
This year we will be visiting the West Coast of Wales to Llain Activity Centre in Llanarth. Below you will find their You Tube Video that shows you all about what their centre is like. This will be our second year of visiting this site but the first time for our current Year 5 's and 6's.
The total cost for this trip is £350. This can be paid in any instalments as you wish as long as the final payment for this trip is completed by 1st June 2026. The deposit and consent form needs to be completed by Monday 3rd November 2025 - the deposit is a non-refundable £30.
